e3.correctness_catch_worth_knowing: The naive token swap `sum(round(x))` -> `round(sum(x))` does NOT compile here. All three sites carry `filter (where …)`, and FILTER may only follow an AGGREGATE call — `round(sum(x)) filter (…)` is a syntax error because round() is not an aggregate. The rewrite is structural: `coalesce(round(sum(x) filter (…)), 0)`, i.e. the paren that closed round() moves to after the filter clause. Caught before apply, written into the migration header as a 🪤 note. `coalesce` is still load-bearing: on an empty set sum() -> null, round(null) -> null, and the 0 still comes from coalesce — empty-set semantics unchanged.
